content_path.description: Proposed own /media/ delivery namespace. ASCII path segments only; no percent-encoding, backslash, dot-segments, whitespace, controls, query, fragment or provider URLs. Server still enforces canonical path and same-origin delivery.

BrowserSession.name: nx_session
BrowserSession.description: Proposed HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookie; server-side active session/account/family check. No proof of existing runtime.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Session-bound synchronizer token plus trusted Origin check; cookie writes require this AND BrowserSession.

UserBearer.description: Validated issuer/audience/type/subject/jti/session-family; role and tenant resolved against current membership, never token role alone.

ApiKey.description: Hash-only storage; server binding to tenant/cost-center/approved inference scopes; revocation checked before every request.

GuestCapability.name: X-NX-Guest-Capability
GuestCapability.description: Short-lived server-issued capability bound to exactly one cart/order and allowed methods; cannot access an account or another tenant.

TenantId.name: X-Tenant-ID
TenantId.description: Selector only. Server requires active membership or exact credential binding; never a grant of authority.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable logical operation key, actor/tenant/operation/payload bound.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exact resource version/ETag; stale writes return409.

schema.description: Server maximum defined by the approved rate/quota policy, not invented in this document.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid credentials; never guest fallback when credentials were supplied.

NotFound.description: Unknown or foreign resource; no tenant existence disclosure.

Conflict.description: Stale version, conflicting idempotency payload, revoked approval, unavailable commercial/legal policy or manual reconciliation required.

Validation.description: Typed field validation failure without echoing secrets or nonfinite values.

Unavailable.description: Dependency/provider contract is unavailable or unverified; no fabricated result.

x-global-authorization.rls: forced database policy plus application ownership; privileged migration identities never accepted as application credentials
x-global-authorization.credential_issuance: No generic business response replay cache for auth or issued key/capability secrets; immutable replay rejection/rotation protocol is separate.

x-source-status: Observed prototype markers and documentary requirements are sources, not runtime evidence. New path/method/schema choices are proposed design.

x-known-functional-gaps.description: Public companion pages do not receive operator API keys or private knowledge credentials. API-key inference and membership-bound knowledge routes are not an anonymous browser BFF. A narrow published-knowledge-only BFF with abuse/budget controls is a separate unresolved contract.

Existing foundation binds actor identity to the administrative database principal/session_user. Shared-pool JWT -> arbitrary actor/tenant GUC is not a validated bridge. No RLS bypass or caller-asserted identity is permitted; existing SQL role tests are not browser SSO proof.
